features: 16 BNC analog inputs (1.0Vp-p, 75 ohm), PAL/NTSC self-adaptive
Supported analog inputs: HD-TVI 8MP/5MP/4MP/3MP/2MP/1MP; AHD 5MP/4MP/2MP/1MP; HD-CVI 4MP/2MP/1MP; CVBS PAL/NTSC
Primary stream max frame rate: 8MP @ 8FPS, 5MP @ 12FPS, 4MP @ 15FPS, 3MP @ 18FPS, 2MP @ 30FPS; sub-stream WD1/4CIF/CIF 30FPS
OWS AI capable (requires additional licensing); Smart Motion: Linux 24; Person & Vehicle: Linux 10 (not supported on analog video)
Analytics include motion, person, vehicle, line crossing, loitering and intrusion detection
Video signal loss detection; recording modes continuous, event, continuous + event
Country of origin: Republic of Korea
notes: Spec sheet gives a max channel count of 24 with up to 16 BNC connections; the number of IP channels in each mode is not stated.
Spec sheet gives 10 Person & Vehicle analytic channels; line card gives 4 (IP only).
Spec sheet and A&E spec give max power consumption of 73W (nominal 59W); line card gives max 70W. Power consumption left out.
Spec sheet and A&E spec give a max operating temperature of 60C; line card gives 40C.
Unit weight is 9.5lbs in all sources; metric weight is given as 4.31kg (spec sheet), 4.3kg (A&E spec) and 4.4kg (line card). Weight left out.
